name: Local means the LAN, in both halves
prose: the app and the engine each decide whether a keyless connection is complete, in separate code (the app cannot import the engine). The engine's copy only knew loopback, so a keyless `http://192.168.1.20:1234/v1` that the app accepted made the engine refuse to boot with "No API key found". Both now cover loopback, `.local`, the private ranges and `host.docker.internal`; nothing asserts the parity any more, which is what makes this one worth writing first.
invariant: The app and the engine agree on whether a keyless connection is complete: both cover loopback, .local, the private ranges and host.docker.internal.
